subject: maths
title: Projectile Pathway
description: Decompose projectile motion into horizontal and vertical components.

concepts.def: Horizontal and vertical motions are independent.
u_x = u cos α, u_y = u sin α for launch speed u, angle α.
x = u_x · t; no acceleration (ignore air resistance).
y = u_y t − ½g t²; acceleration −g.
Set y = 0 to find t when projectile lands (level ground).
R = (u² sin 2α)/g on level ground; max at α=45°.
